feature-decl.comment: F1 (R1.A audit) — feature-decl is now begin/end so the feature body has a stable enclosing scope. Body patterns mirror the top-level set minus other top-level kinds (app/workspace/contract/etc.) and stop at the next top-level declaration via `end: ^(?=\S)`.

uses-experience-decl.comment: Phase 4.2 — `uses experience <name>` line inside `surface X <platform>` bodies (.lzx). Colors `uses experience` as paired statement keywords and the name as a reference.

permission-decl.comment: Phase 3 — `permission <id>` is a leaf catalog entry (no body). Single-line match per RBAC vocab proposal.

role-decl.comment: Phase 3 — `role <name>` opens a block whose children are `inherits <role>` and exactly one of `grants` / `grants_all` (or neither). Body covered by the begin/end form below.

patterns.comment: `grants` block-opener (bare line) lists permission refs one per indent.
Relation `on_delete` closed catalog: cascade | restrict | nullify (modifiers list at lib.rs:2151 and IR has_many semantics).

enum-block.comment: Inside enum bodies, members are bare identifiers — no statement keywords; this is the primary fix for `prompt`/`contract`/`integration`/`deprecated` over-coloring.

filters-block.comment: Expression context. NO statement keywords; only operators, refs, identifiers.

patterns.comment: Map-key policy actions on policies entries (`read: ...`, `write: ...`).

emits-block.comment: Bare `emits` block at indent 2 in a feature, listing `event <name>` declarations.

patterns.comment: Hash algorithm closed catalog (lazuli_lsp AUTH_CATALOG_VALUES @ lib.rs:14064; LSP doctor enforces `argon2id`/`bcrypt` only at lib.rs:2906). `scrypt` recognized for forward-compat.
OAuth provider closed catalog (lazuli_lsp AUTH_CATALOG_VALUES @ lib.rs:14064-14074).
MFA method closed catalog (lazuli_lsp AUTH_CATALOG_VALUES @ lib.rs:14064-14074).

cache-block.comment: Inline cache sub-block on a query, OR feature-level cache profile.

patterns.comment: algorithm closed catalog (lazuli_ir EncryptionAlgorithm @ encryption.rs:150-167). v0 = `aes_256_gcm`; chacha20_poly1305 deferred but recognized for forward-compat.
rotation closed catalog (lazuli_ir EncryptionRotation @ encryption.rs:170-180). v0 = `manual`; kms_managed deferred but recognized.
route <name>: <Type> — sugars to a typed route slot.
Effect verbs (creates/updates/deletes/returns) followed by a Resource/Record name. Captures the verb + entity.

audit-block.comment: audit field-list line, OR bare audit (block opener) followed by emit_to. R1.A audit fix: `audit none|default` are closed-catalog modes (not field names), so they get `constant.language.audit-mode.lazuli` via the more-specific match below; arbitrary field lists keep `variable.other.audit-fields.lazuli`.

emits-sub-block.comment: Inside command/job: `emits` block-opener (bare) listing event-name lines.

patterns.comment: F3 (R1.A audit) — `mode contains|prefix|exact` closed-catalog. Used in every faceted `query.list search`. Catalog source: lazuli_lsp keyword_description "mode contains|prefix|exact".

view-drawer-block.comment: Phase 4.3 — L0 #6 `drawer <name> on select|open` block. Children: source/route/sections/cells/actions.

view-search-segmented-block.comment: Phase 4.3 — L0 #6 `search segmented` block. Children: `field <key> binds <BindingRef>`, `free text into <BindingRef>`.

view-settings-block.comment: Phase 4.3 — L0 #6 `settings` block. Children are `<name>: <Type>` typed setting decls; each may carry a child `persist local|workspace|none` line.

view-filters-decl-block.comment: Phase 4.3 — L0 #6 `filters` declaration block on a view list (NOT the same as the expression-context `filters` on a `query.list` body, which lives in `#filters-block`). Children are typed slot decls: `<name>: <Type>`, `<name>: list of <Type>`, `<name>: <Type> from query`.

patterns.comment: URL sync suffix: `<name>: <Type> from query` — colors `from query` distinctly.

extends-block.comment: Top-level `extends X` for cross-feature view extension at .lzx file scope.

bare-block-opener.comment: Catch-all for block-opener keywords that appear bare on a line. Section-style coloring without forcing a specific child grammar. Phase 3 audit: added `events`, `records`, `operations`, `constraints`, `webhook_events`, `lifecycle`, `evals`, `tools`, `digest`, `throttle`, `replay`, `cursor`, `selection`, `bulk_actions`, `settings`, `sort`, `filter`, `search`, `drawer`, `imports`, `uses`, `subscriptions`, `roles`, `permissions`, `grants`, `view`, `audience` for completeness in workspace/registry/contract bodies and L0 #6 view bodies.

field-decl.comment: Field declaration `name: Type [decorators] [modifiers]`. Captures only the name + colon; the type after the colon falls through to `#types` so primitive/UI/extension/domain scopes apply uniformly (avoids the inconsistency where field-decl marked types as `support.type.domain` while bare types in route/return slots got the more specific `support.type.primitive`).

statements-app-meta.comment: App-level metadata key/value lines. Limited to known scalars; only matches when followed by a value to avoid bare-line over-coloring.

statements-feature-meta.comment: Feature-scoped metadata that requires a same-line value (kills bare over-color). F4/F7 (R1.A audit): dropped duplicates of `context` and `model`, plus dropped keywords already covered by their dedicated blocks (`trigger`/`schedule`/`queue` → job/notification, `prompt`/`safety`/`stream`/`temperature`/`max_tokens`/`top_p`/`seed`/`tools` → agent, `template` → notification/error_page, `catalog`/`namespace`/`sql`/`topic` → translation/cache/query.sql/event, `tenant_from`/`target`/`targets`/`tenant`/`reason` → command/job/scope). Kept `to` (used in route bodies which lack a dedicated block) and the genuine feature-meta directives.

feature-uses-imports-list.comment: F2 (R1.A audit) — `uses`/`imports`/`requires` comma-separated feature-name list. Verb gets statement scope; each identifier in the list gets `entity.name.type.feature.lazuli` for parity with the `feature-decl` capture. The list-of-identifiers regex tolerates whitespace around commas; the verb pattern requires same-line value (avoids matching `uses` as a bare block opener).

patterns.comment: Verb + first identifier + remaining (`, ident`)* — verb and first ident captured; trailing identifiers handled by the secondary pattern below.

feature-retention-line.comment: Closed-catalog retention modifiers (R1.A audit — `retention 7y then anonymize`, `retention forever then anonymize`). Two-step: (1) duration `<n><unit>|forever`; (2) `then <action>`. Action catalog drawn from LSP retention semantics: `anonymize|delete|archive`.

patterns.comment: `then anonymize|delete|archive` connector inside a retention line.
`forever` token used as a retention duration sentinel.
patterns.name: constant.language.retention-duration.lazuli

patterns.comment: gate behind plan.feature: <ref> | gate quota plan.limit: <ref>
Parameterized decorator with named args, e.g. `@cap.File(max_size: "10mb", accept: "png")`. Uses begin/end so arg-keys inside parens can be highlighted as `variable.parameter`.
Non-parameterized decorator with a Name suffix, e.g. `@semantic.GeoPoint`.
patterns.name: entity.name.tag.lazuli

patterns.comment: Decorator references with a lowercase member, e.g. `@policy.member`, `@scope.workspace_member`, `@fn.hash_password`. Colored as HTML-tag for theme compatibility.
patterns.name: entity.name.tag.lazuli

patterns.comment: Phase 2.4 — context-root reference path. Splits the ROOT (input/ctx/output/payload/route/row/audit/source/target/tenant/schedule/envelope/tools/self/filters/selection) from the LEAF chain so themes can give the root a distinct accent. ROOT colored as `support.variable.context.lazuli`; LEAF segments fall through to the catch-all semantic reference as `variable.other.member.lazuli`.

Phase 2.5 — capitalized model path. ROOT (Resource/Record name) colored as `support.type.domain.lazuli`; LEAF chain (`.field` or `.SubField`) falls through to `variable.other.member.lazuli`. Distinct from the bare `[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]+` type pattern in `#types` because we want the leaf to read as a member access, not a chained type.
Phase 4.4 — UI component-type catalog. Added `Modal` and `Stepper` per HIGHLIGHTING-CHECKLIST §4.4 (catalog completeness). Other entries unchanged.
patterns.name: support.type.ui.lazuli

http-methods.comment: Generic HTTP method tokens. Inclusion-only; emit `constant.language` so themes color them like `true`/`false`.
